observations: Aahlin et al. published “Functional recovery is considered the most important target: a survey of dedicated professionals” in Perioperative Medicine in 2014 (doi:10.1186/2047-0525-3-5).

The title explicitly frames the survey's conclusion as functional recovery being considered the most important target; the retrieved bibliographic record did not include the abstract or quantitative survey results.
